welcome: 👋 Hi, {name}! Welcome to {company} support. Find an answer in the FAQ, contact our team, or follow your tickets — choose below.
faq_empty: The FAQ is empty for now. Contact support and our team will help you.
search_miss: 🤔 I couldn't find an answer to that. Open the FAQ or contact our support team.
support_department: 💬 Contact support Which department do you need?
support_describe: ✍️ Describe your issue in one message. You can attach photos, videos, files or a voice message.
ticket_created: ✅ Ticket {number} is created. Status: {status} We'll answer in this chat. To add details, just write here.
tickets_title: 🎫 Your tickets Choose one to see the details:
ticket_write: ✍️ Write your message — it goes to ticket {number}.
ticket_reopened: 🔄 Ticket {number} is open again. Write your message.
reopen_expired: This ticket was closed too long ago. Please create a new one.
status_pending_user: ❓ Ticket {number}: we need a little more information from you. Please reply in this chat.
status_resolved: ✅ Ticket {number} is resolved. How would you rate our support?
status_closed: 🔒 Ticket {number} is closed. If you need anything else, just write.
offline_note: 🌙 Our team works {hours} ({timezone}). We'll answer as soon as we're back.
banned: ⛔ You can't contact support from this account.
rate_limit: ⏳ Too many messages. Please wait a minute.
unsupported: This kind of message can't be sent to support. Please send text, a photo, a video, a file or a voice message.
news_off: 🔕 You won't receive announcements anymore. Send /news to subscribe again.
link_ok: ✅ This Telegram account is linked to the dashboard account {name}. You'll get support notifications here.
link_bad: This code is wrong or expired. Get a new one in the dashboard (Profile → Telegram notifications).
about: {company} support: answers to common questions and help from our team.
keyboard_hint: 👇 The menu is always at the bottom of the screen.
temporary: ⚠️ Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a minute.
file_too_large: 📎 This file is too large. Please send a file up to 19 MB or a link to it.
ticket_closed: This ticket is closed. Open «My tickets» to reopen it or create a new one.
staff_note_prompt: 📝 {number}: write an internal note. Only the team sees it.
staff_denied: This ticket isn't available to your account, or your role can't do this.
staff_closed: Ticket {number} is closed. Reopen it in the dashboard first.
contacts_bad_email: This doesn't look like an e-mail address. Please check it and try again.
contacts_not_own: Please share your own phone number with the button below.
contacts_bad_phone: This phone number can't be saved. Please share it with the button below.
staff_weekly_report: 📊 Week {period}: {created} new tickets, {resolved} resolved, {open} open, {overdue} overdue. SLA {sla}, rating {csat}.
reminder_pending_user: ⏰ Ticket {number} is waiting for your reply. Please answer in this chat so we can continue.
